text: :"Unto each of you is given a gift; unto all of you is given the duty." , Malygos, Alexstrasza, Ysera, and Neltharion.]] .]] The Dragon Aspects (also called Great Aspects, Aspects of Azeroth or simply Aspects) are the leaders of the five dragonflights, empowered by the titans to protect Azeroth. Since the defeat of Deathwing, they have originally lost their titan-given power, which they sacrificed in order to empower the Dragon Soul. They would later regain them as a blessing from Azeroth herself after reclaiming their ancestral home, the Dragon Isles, from the threat of the Primal Incarnates.
Amnwater No.1 was a beer exported from the town of Amnwater and could be found throughout North Faerûn and Sword Coast.

The Dragons of Nightmare (a.k.a. Nightmare Dragons) were four green dragons corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare. Formerly Ysera's lieutenants, the four caused havoc across Azeroth for years until being stopped. Three were slain and one was redeemed. They were Lethon, Emeriss, Ysondre and Taerar. These dragons were world spawns located in Duskwood (Twilight Grove), the Hinterlands (Seradane), Feralas (Dream Bough), and Ashenvale (Bough Shadow). The dragons were removed following Cataclysm. It was later revealed that Lethon and Emeriss were killed during the War Against the Nightmare, Ysondre freed herself from the Nightmare's corruption, and Taerar is killed during the Feralas storyline in Taerar's Fall, ending the Dragons of Nightmare's corrupt influence. They would return, however, when Xavius and the Nightmare resurfaced as bosses within the Emerald Nightmare raid. Since the WoW's 13th Anniversary, the Dragons of Nightmare have returned for the anniversary event along with daily quest The Originals.
__NOTOC__ * The archwizard Lady Polaris asks the people of Algid if they would like their town to be turned into a flying enclave. The simple fisherfolk refuse her.

Acamar was a star-like entity from the Far Realm who had taken a place among stars of Realmspace. Unlike normal stars, Acamar didn't have a fixed place in the sky but instead danced and wavered across Realmspace.
An apparatus of Kwalish was a large metallic vehicle that resembled a lobster. It was capable of moving on land, on water, and underwater.

Aerdrie Faenya (), also known as Queen of the Avariel, was an elven goddess of the Seldarine. During the time of the Spellplague, she held her position by serving as the fey aspect of the Faerûnian goddess and primordial, Akadi. However, with the coming of the Second Sundering, she was once again an independent goddess.

Alasklerbanbastos, also known as the Great Bone Wyrm, and the self-proclaimed Dragon King of Old Unther, was an ancient blue dracolich who ruled Threskel from his lair within Dragonback Mountain. He held the distinction of being the only dracolich to have his physical form destroyed twice in the same year.
Astanalan was an emerald dragon and one of the Princes of Murghôm in 1479 DR.
Anya was a fighter who died during a fight with the minions of Xanathar circa 1358 DR.

Belaphoss the Mad () was a powerful balor who served as a lieutenant of the demon lord Demogorgon. His chief ambition was to become a demon lord himself, and supplant Demogorgon as ruler of the Gaping Maw.
Buchembrallor was a green dragon living in Cape Velen in 1373 DR.
Carston was a very powerful mage who managed to control the Machine of Lum the Mad.

Ankheg plate mail was a type of chitin armor, a suit of armor crafted from the chitinous shell of an ankheg. Despite its name, it was not true plate mail but rather offered its wearer similar protection in combat and could be worn by druids. This armor was highly valued for its lightness, as it weighed significantly less than metal plate armor. As such it cost anywhere from 4,000 - 6,000 gp and took between one to three days to be made.
Daelfyrthimachian, also known as The Jet-Boned Tyrant, was a dracolich ruler who lived in or near Skelkor, Laerakond, in Abeir, centuries before the Spellplague.
Fire minions were fearsome creatures from the Elemental Plane of Fire, some of whom had migrated to the sun in Realmspace.
Frizzerfrazz was a young gold dragon living in the Aphrunn Mountains in Turmish in 1358 DR and 1374 DR.
Andout was a messenger who lived in the Sword Coast during the mid–14 century DR.
The Child of Bones is a unique Bone Colossus that appears in The Wailing Prison in . It is the final creature to be defeated by the Vestige in order to escape from Coldharbour with the Prophet.

, the First Dragonborn, in Apocrypha.]] Dragonborn, also referred to as Dovahkiin in the Dragon Language, are individuals with the body of a mortal, but the blood and soul of a Dragon. Some believe that Dragonborn appear on the world in times of great need by the command of the Gods.
Exkeleku is a powerful spiritual Harvester found inside the ruins of Skyreach Pinnacle.
An animated armor, or just a suit of armor for brevity, was a suit of armor that was crafted with magic to follow the command of its creators.

Hircine (Daedric script, ) is the main antagonist in and the Daedric Prince whose spirit is the hunt; the sports of Daedra; the greatest game and the chase and sacrifice of mortals. He is known by the titles "The Huntsman of The Princes," "The Father of Manbeasts" and "The Hungry Cat" to Khajiit. The summoning date of Hircine is the 5th of Mid Year. He is also the creator of Lycanthropy.
Ironscale Dragon is a creature card in added with the Heroes of Skyrim expansion.
Lonely Giant is a powerful Giant found with his two Mammoths inside the cave in The Lion's Den.

Anna is a common name in the Realms. This name could refer to: * Anna (Sword Coast), the person from the Sword Coast who loved the fisher Sy; * Anna (Zhentil Keep), the server from Zhentil Keep; or * Tatyana, the Barovian woman who was the target of obsession of Strahd von Zarovich.

Lyris Titanborn is a Nord and partial giant who is a member of the original Five Companions. She is first encountered while fleeing from Coldharbour through The Wailing Prison, joining the Vestige on the way towards the Prophet, and later returns to help Tamriel.
Naaslaarum (Dragon Language: Naas–Laar–Um, "Tooth–Water–Twin") is a Revered Dragon found in .
Numinex (Dragon Language: ) is the name of the dragon that was shouted into submission by king Olaf One-Eye atop Mount Anthor in Skyrim.
The Argus Treader was a Gontese merchant ship owned by Captain Madwave of Szant.

Ruptga, also known as Tall Papa, is the chief god of the Yokudan pantheon. According to legend, he was formed around the time when the First Serpent shed its skin, creating Satakal. He learned the Walkabout, a way of avoiding the cycle of Satakal eating itself by moving in strange angles and striding between the worldskins. Ruptga placed stars in the sky to help other, weaker spirits perform the Walkabout, and it became so easy that it became a place, called The Far Shores. Ruptga fathered so many children over the course of the cycles that he became known as Tall Papa. Most Prominent among his children are Frandar Hunding, Leki and Ansei. After many cycles, there were so many spirits that Tall Papa couldn't guide them all by himself anymore, so he created a helper out of the dead skins of previous worlds, called Sep. Sep still had much of the hunger of Satakal in him, and often ate the spirits he was supposed to help, though Tall Papa always got them out. Sep eventually grew tired of helping Tall Papa and decided to trick the other spirits into creating a new world by balling up the remains of the old worlds, telling them that this new world would make it easier to get to the Far Shores. Tall Papa just shook his head at this. Many of the spirits who pertook in creating Sep's new world died, and those who remained found that the jump to the Far Shores was too far now. They pleaded with Tall Papa for help, but he just told them that they must now find new ways to follow the st
The Silent Colossus is a powerful Bone Colossus found in the Forgotten Crypts.
The Scion of Wroth is a Daedric Titan found in the Shattered Void in the Imperial City, and is the last minor boss before the The Planar Inhibitor and Molag Kena.
The Ardeep River was a river in the Sword Coast North region, a few miles southeast of Waterdeep, between the River Dessarin and the River Delimbiyr.
Yandir the Butcher is a Sea Giant that appears in . It is the first boss fought in Kyne's Aegis.
Mother or Matriarch is the oldest, wisest, and strongest of all the hairy deathclaws found in and around Chicago.
Hilgigars is a boss from Final Fantasy IX fought on the Conde Petie Mountain Path. His name is a mistranslation of "Hill Gigas". His rare steal, the Fairy Flute, is notoriously difficult to get.
Armor of loyalty was a type of light armor that protected the wearer from magical charming.

Kisana is a minor character in Final Fantasy: Legend of the Crystals. It is a colossal dark sea creature with a large dorsal fin. It is unknown exactly what Kisana is, nor is its relationship with Linaly expanded upon. However, it can be deduced to be form of river guardian looking out for her.
Energy Blast is a technique of Yhwach following his absorption of the Soul King and derived from the latter's dark Reiatsu. __TOC__
Prince is the hill giant ruler of Gundergrunch, the new name for the Pools of Wittebak.
Armor of the clerics of Myrkul were sets of enchanted Myrkulyte plate mail worked by the members of the Lord of the Dead's clergy.
s are a subtype of reilora, the crimson entities which inhabit the red moon Ruidus. They are the tallest and most massive of the reilora.
Remorhazes are huge segmented insectoid monstrosities that roam the northern lands of Exandria.
Tatterwing is a green dragon from the Kirmont Valley, in Tal'Dorei.
The armor of Horus was an enchanted suit of scale mail that also provided resistance to all forms of lightning and fire attacks.

Tiamat, the Scaled Tyrant is the evil queen of dragons. She is a fearsome goddess of greed, envy, and hoarded wealth, and the patron of most chromatic dragons. She is the sworn enemy of the Platinum Dragon.
Umudara, the Sentinel Beast, is one of the Great Beasts of Veluthil, the protector spirits of the Veluthil Forest in the time of Molaesmyr, before the forest became corrupted into the Savalirwood.

Brakion, Genesis Mind is a Vex Mind that controlled the Pyramidion on Io. He is also the Mind responsible for taking the arm of the Warlock Asher Mir. He is the final boss in the Destiny 2 strike The Pyramidion.

Asaudrae Daerantree was a human priestess of Mielikki who lived in Amphail on the Sword Coast North in the 11 century DR. She was the origin of the annual Rite of the Stag Lass celebrated in that village.

Basilius the Golem was a Cabal Colossus of the Red Legion stationed on Mars. Ordered to head off world by his long deceased Valus, Basilius sought to augment his body to become even stronger and after his arrival on Europa, aspired to become the first of his battalion to become a Cabal Exo. He would be one of many aspiring champions seeking to join Empress Caiatl's War Council through the Rite of Proving.
The Barricade Mind is a Vex Hydra of the Nessian Schism. It had stolen an Acceleron and would be destroyed by the Guardian in order to acquire it to disperse the temporal blockages on Kepler.

Deceived Colossi are Major Cabal Colossi that were lured by Drifter to compete in games of Gambit. They appear in advanced waves, using their power to halt the progress of the team. They drop five Motes of Dark upon death.
Armor of thorns was an unsettling leather armor that was rumored to hold some malevolent intelligence or influence.
Karl is a Titan who works as a bouncer at the Seven Stars. He was directed by the owners of the Seven Stars to throw out "Lady" Olu Alderdice and anyone who possessed the Hunter's devious inventions.

Oxus, Herald of the Plague is a giant Taken Minotaur seen in the Blind Well. It is a subordinate of Inomina, Plague of the Well, and can be seen with Kydoimos, Herald of the Plague and Kakos, Herald of the Plague.

Niruul, the Hollow Voice was a Psion Flayer for the Red Legion seen hidden within Mercury's future. A co-leader along with her Psion Sisters, she represented Void energy and was the third-born in her family. She served as the first boss among the rotating bosses of The Sundial.
The Ash Ridge was a mountainous area of the Sword Mountains , along the Thunderhoof Pass.
Prusk, the Unequaled Maul was a Cabal Colossus that appeared as the main boss of the Dark Alliance Adventure in the European Dead Zone. They were infused with Taken energy by Corrupted Bonded Psions.
Ta'aul, Disgraced Colossus is a Red Legion Colossus encountered in the Warden of Nothing Strike.
Tokki is an unpartnered Ghost searching for her Guardian beyond Saturn.

Arthoum was the smallest of the islands west of the shores of the fortress library of Candlekeep on the Sword Coast. During the century that followed the Spellplague, it was a part of the Cimarine Isles.

Xivu Arath, God of War, formerly known as Xi Ro, is a Hive god and youngest sister to Savathûn, the Witch Queen and Oryx, the Taken King. Together with her two siblings, she was a progenitor of the contemporary Hive species and one of its chief gods, having made a pact with the Worms of Fundament. She is driven to become the mightiest warrior in the universe, and her influence is present wherever armed conflict takes place.

Zaim, God of the Mountains, is a deity of the Sahptev faith. Like Ytar, many s seek the patronage of this god, per them prizing strength and resolve. Zaim once had part of his strength stolen by Ymil. By calling upon Zaim's power, a Monk can gain limited [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Psychometry_(paranormal) psychometry] to see past events that happened at a particular location.
MegaDarknessBagramon is a gigantic DarknessBagramon. Attacks *Mega God of Death Snatcher *Mega Darkness Snatcher
Armoghh's Armoire of Arms and Armor was a store in Loudwater in the Delimbiyr Vale in the mid–14 century DR.

The Saneiketsu (三英傑 San'eiketsu, lit. "The Three Excellent Heroes") are a group of three powerful masculine Digimon who protect the Genshi Continent, and also a title earned by valuing highly martial prowess in the battle. They believe the survival of the fittest is the natural order of the world in which Digimon live. They are all members of the Tentei Hachibushu. They are also all members of the Saiyu Warriors Field. =Overview= The Saneiketsu are composed of three members of the Tentei Hachibushu, namely Erlangmon, Takutoumon, and Nezhamon. Erlangmon acts with the conviction to rid all Digimon of their wicked hearts, and others refer to it as an upright Digimon due to the way it is honest. Also, the on its forehead has the power to see through the opponent's weak spots and wicked hearts. Erlangmon: Blast Mode is its awakened form, unleashing its power to the utmost limit only when eliminating enemies that it is incapable of defeating. Erlangmon has also been keeping a close watch on Seiten Gokuwmon’s every move, as Seiten Gokuwmon is a Digimon of the strongest class, rivalling the Tentei Hachibushu, and is a free being who is neither bound by destiny nor constraints. Takutoumon is a hero who despises deceiving others, and uses its sword to resolve actions that deviate from the path of righteousness. It frequently imposes its own sense of justice onto others, and since it does not even make the effort to explain itself again, it often fights alone. Its treasure tool, "", con

artwork by John Schoenherr]] Shai-Hulud was the Fremen term for the sandworm of Arrakis. As with many Fremen terms and words, Shai-Hulud was more than a descriptive term for a physical entity. Specifically, it often alluded to the Fremen belief that the sandworm was a physical embodiment of the One God that created and governed the universe. Thus to the Fremen Shai-Hulud was a sacred term that was usually spoken with a tone of awe, fear, or respect. Linguistically, Shai-Hulud had many poetic translations, all of which spoke of the size, age, and power of the sandworm. Among the noted translations were: * "Old Man of the Desert" * "Old Father Eternity" * "Grandfather of the Desert"
Arakajda is a death giant operating in the Mournland. There, she and her sister, Behkorr, hunt for souls to take.
The Armor of Landfall was a set of druidic light armor that granted the wearer the ability to grow plant life magically, found in the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Baron Esravash d'Lyrandar is one of the youngest matriarchs in the history of House Lyrandar. She had her seat of power on Stormhome, an island just north of the coast of Aundair. The once-desolate island has been transformed by Lyrandar mages and is now a popular resort destination as well as the home of Esravash. Esravash is sometimes referred to as "firstborn", for members believe that Lyran and Selavash speak through the house leaders.
Dularanahk was a powerful red dragon from the Age of Demons.

Jungle giants are nomadic wanderers who roam the jungles of Xen'drik. Unlike some other giants, they are more interested in keeping the jungle and its animal inhabitants protected than in vengeance or combat. However, they have long memories, remembering grudges or favors made many years earlier.
Armors of comfort were enchanted sets of heavy armor that were masterfully crafted to be soft and comfortable on the inside.

Militha is a character who appears in the Fire Emblem: Hasha no Tsurugi manga. Belonging to the ancient race of dragons known as Archdragons, Militha is the mother of the manga's protagonist Al and the wife of the leader of the Eight Legends, Hartmut.
Surtr is the main antagonist of Book II of Fire Emblem Heroes. Ruler of the Kingdom of Múspell, he is also the father of Laegjarn and Laevatein.
Ourea (Greek: Οὔρεα) is the Primordial God of the Mountains.
Artificial leech was a surgical tool occasionally used as a weapon, that possessed a minor enchantment.
Brinelin is the Zendikar Moon Kraken that ruled the waters of the bays of Akoum.
Darux is a Rakdos Spiker and Ringleader from Ravnica - a pierced titan towering over the members of his ring.
Doran, the Siege Tower, was an immense black poplar treefolk from the plane of Lorwyn.
Armors of devotion were enchanted sets of plate mail armor imbued with defensive holy magics.
Dragonhawk, also called the Storm Hawk, is an anomaly on the plane of Bloomburrow - a being that behaves much like a Calamity Beast, but is neither truly from the plane nor an elemental creature.

Emeria or Em is the Merfolk goddess of the realms of the sky, wind, and clouds on Zendikar. The name Emeria is also used for the Skyclave above Tazeem, where it was believed the goddess once dwelt. Emeria is known as Kamsa by the Kor and is their goddess of the wind, the breath of the world. Both deities are female and come from the same source: long-lost memories of the terrible Eldrazi Emrakul.
Ghalta, "the predator's appetite," is an elder dinosaur from Ixalan.
The armor of the sporekeeper was rare enchanted variety of light armor created to boost the abilities of the Circle of Spores druids sometime before the late 15 century DR.
Grolnok is a massive frog worshiped as a deity in Nephalia, Innistrad.
Karrthus, called the "Tyrant of Jund", is a dragon Ajani Goldmane encountered on his first planeswalk.

Kaalia is a powerful double-winged human cleric from Alara, tormented by her past and scarred by devastation. In addition to her powers of flight, she has stonebreaking magic and the ability to beckon angels, dragons and demons to battle.

Armor of vulnerability, also known as plate mail of vulnerability, was a type of cursed plate armor that posed more harm to threats than protection, often created with the intent of tricking one's foes into wearing them.
Kalamax, the Stormsire, is a legendary elemental dinosaur from the plane of Ikoria.
Krothuss is an ancient kraken horror from Nephalia, Innistrad.
Kura is a dragon spirit from Kamigawa. She is the reincarnation of Jugan.

The armor of the Warblade, also known as the Warblade's reflection, was a kind of clothing and armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR, magically derived from the legendary Warblade.

Polukranos (Poh-LOO-krahn-ohs), also known as World Eater, is a gigantic legendary Hydra from Theros. As the mortal manifestation of the eternal ideal of a hydra, it emerges when the magic that holds the pillars of the world is shaken. It is a herald of terrible times when the fate of the poleis and civilization are in the balance.

Ulasht is a legendary hydra that inhabits the ruins of Ravnica left behind by the Gruul Clans. Ulasht is unique in that its multiple heads are hellions, a worm-like creature with tentacles surrounding a tooth-filled mouth. Though not officially a part of any clan, it is revered by many Gruul as a natural embodiment of pure destruction and mindless rage.
The Yuki-Onna () was a powerful elemental spirit of cold and frost on the plane of Kamigawa. She resided in the Heart of Frost, one of the mountains in the Tendo Peaks region of Sokenzan Range.

The armor of the Artblade, also known as the Artblade's reflection, was a kind of clothing and armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR, magically derived from the legendary Artblade.
Zetalpa, "the elder of dawn," is an elder dinosaur from Ixalan.
Ziatora is the crime-lord and boss of the Riveteers family in New Capenna. She is a Dragon Demon.
The is a Dragon King responsible for governing the Hong River.

The armor of the Crownblade, also known as the Crownblade's reflection, was a kind of clothing and armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR, magically derived from the legendary Crownblade.
Mr. Incredible, also known as Bob, is a character in Kingdom Hearts Union χ. He is a superhero with great strength.
Bicorn is a bicorn choushin, who's also the manifestation of the God of Wrath.
Dai King is the vampire Kaiju that kidnaps people from Planet Kinniku.
The armor of midnight was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Aesi, the Tyrant of Gyre Strait, is a serpent from an unknown plane.
The Cinematic Phoenix is a legendary phoenix from an unknown plane.
Darux is a Rakdos Spiker and Ringleader from Ravnica - a pierced titan towering over the members of his ring.
The armor of moonlight was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Doran, the Siege Tower, was an immense black poplar treefolk from the plane of Lorwyn.

Emeria or Em is the Merfolk goddess of the realms of the sky, wind, and clouds on Zendikar. The name Emeria is also used for the Skyclave above Tazeem, where it was believed the goddess once dwelt. Emeria is known as Kamsa by the Kor and is their goddess of the wind, the breath of the world. Both deities are female and come from the same source: long-lost memories of the terrible Eldrazi Emrakul.
Ghalta, "the predator's appetite," is an elder dinosaur from Ixalan.
The armor of the new moon was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Goddric is a Dragon from Eldraine who disguised himself as a Human Noble man.
Jarga is a massive troll who was part of Vraska's coup to take over leadership in the Golgari Swarm.

Inniaz the Gale Force is a legendary female djinn from the plane of Dominaria, whose power comes from storms. The wishes she grants come with an additional, equivalent cost. For example, a wish for extended life might cost the lifespan of a loved one; treasures and gold may cost an irreplaceable sentimental item. For this reason, one has to wish carefully, because a djinn's magic cannot be undone.
The armor of sunset was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Krothuss is an ancient kraken horror from Nephalia, Innistrad.
Lyra Dawnbringer is an angel Commander of the Serra Angels of the Order of Dawn and Protector of Benalia on Dominaria.
Zetalpa, "the elder of dawn," is an elder dinosaur from Ixalan.
The armor of sunlight was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.
Ziatora is the crime-lord and boss of the Riveteers family in New Capenna. She is a Dragon Demon.
Cloud is a character from Square Enix and the protagonist of Final Fantasy VII, who appears in the Kingdom Hearts series.

Drax the Destroyer is a Marvel Comics superhero who is a member of the Guardians of the Galaxy. He is one of the protagonists of the Guardians of the Galaxy film series. Drax is a warrior whose family was murdered by Ronan the Accuser, Drax seeks vengeance on all those responsible or involved in his family's deaths, but comes to find a new one in his teammates. Drax the Destroyer was created by Jim Starlin and Mike Friedrich.
The armor of midday was a suit of armor found in Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.

Hades is the main antagonist of Disney's 1997 animated feature film Hercules. He is the fast-talking god of the Underworld, known for having a fiery temper and a vendetta against his oldest brother, Zeus. Over the span of 18 years, Hades developed a scheme to take over Mount Olympus and the cosmos, but a prophecy revealed by the Fates foretold that a hero would rise against him and end his reign. While the Hades of Greek mythology was not particularly malevolent, the Disney version portrays him as an evil figure, albeit comedic. This interpretation of the character proved successful, making Hades one of Disney’s most popular antagonists, and a primary member of the Disney Villains line-up.

Iron Man (real name Anthony Edward "Tony" Stark) is a superhero from Marvel Comics and the Marvel Cinematic Universe, first appearing in the 2008 film Iron Man. Tony Stark is a genius, billionaire, playboy, and philanthropist. He not only invented the Iron Man Armor, but wears the suit himself. He is a resourceful co-leader and one of the founding members of the Avengers. He is the CEO of Stark Industries, which once sold highly sophisticated weapons systems technologies to the government defense organizations such as S.H.I.E.L.D., who uses them to maintain peace and order, but has pulled his company away from the weapons business once he saw the damage they caused. Tony passed away in Avengers: Endgame, after sacrificing himself to erase Thanos and his army from existence, leaving his wife, Pepper, a widow, and a daughter named Morgan Stark. Following his death, Iron Man's legacy still continued to inspire those, specifically Riri Williams, known as Ironheart, who built her own suits like Tony, and Spider-Man, who had to deal with the fact that members of the public expected him to follow in Tony Stark's footsteps to be the next Iron Man. Iron Man was created by Stan Lee, Larry Lieber and Don Heck.
The Laestrygonians are minor antagonists of the Disney+ series Percy Jackson and the Olympians. They are dumb mindless giants who work for Luke Castellan in Kronos's army.
Armors of quick recovery were a variety of light armor used by the adventurers in the Chultan city of Port Nyanzaru in the late 15 century DR.

The "Maidmasher" (voiced by Ólafur Darri Ólafsson) is one of the nine man-eating giants that live in Giant Country. He has a small head and almost invisible hair. Among the gang of man-eating giants, the Maidmasher seems to have the best sense of fashion considering the way he dresses. He, along with the Fleshlumpeater, Bloodbottler, Meatdripper, Gizzardgulper, Manhugger, Bonecruncher, Childchewer, and Butcher Boy enjoy snatching and gobbling up little children at night while The BFG delivers dreams to the children.

The Midgard Serpent is a giant serpent from a jungle-like dimension presumed to be beneath Yggdrasil. This version of the mythological Midgard Serpent was created by Stan Lee, Jack Kirby, Steve Englehart, and John Buscema.
Paul Bunyan is the protagonist of the Disney 1958 animated short of the same name.
Artak was a shipowner of the Sword Coast in the late 14 century DR.
Pecos Bill is the titular protagonist from the segment of the same name in the 1948 Disney package film, Melody Time.

Sun Park is a character in American Dragon: Jake Long. She is Jake, Spud, and Trixie's Home Economics teacher. She appears to be a pacifist, but is later revealed to be the Korean Dragon, having come to be Haley's dragon teacher.
Thailog is a clone of Goliath from Disney's Gargoyles created by Dr. Anton Sevarius, who has the morals and mental processes of Xanatos.
Asbras Orthwood was a human fighter and Purple Dragon highknight of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR. He was a member of the Orthwood noble family.

Terrax is one of Galactus' heralds. He has the power of the Earth. He was a Warlord before he became one of Galactus Heralds. He is the enemy of the Fantastic Four and Silver Surfer. Terrax was created by Marv Wolfman and John Byrne.

The Blot is the main antagonist of Epic Mickey and its remake. A destructive giant monster made of paint and thinner accidentally created by Mickey Mouse, the Blot long rampages Wasteland, seeking a way to escape it and continue its terror in Mickey's world.
The Giant's Wife (or The Giant) is the main antagonist of the 2014 Disney film Into the Woods.
Arvoreniad was an enchanted short sword of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.

King Kong is a fictional giant ape and the antagonist of the , as well as the inspiration for Donkey Kong. In 1982, King Kong was the subject of a lawsuit against Nintendo by Universal Studios, who claimed that the character and scenario of the game Donkey Kong infringed on Universal's rights to the King Kong character. The turnout was, among other reasons, decided through acknowledgement that King Kong was a public-domain character, allowing him to make appearances in some Super Mario media.

Armor of durability was an item enchantment that allowed certain armors to boost their wearers' recovery powers.
Barum an is a superhuman type Warrior Beast who appears at the conclusion of the Mazinger Z manga by Gosaku Ōta.

The Dragonsaurus (ドラゴノサウルス) is a prehistoric monster that first appeared in Grendizer, Getter Robo G, Great Mazinger: Kessen! Daikaiju and appeared again in Mazinger Angels. It is a very powerful enemy, that in both appearances needed three highly powerful super robots in order to destroy it.
Hercules is a Superhuman Warrior Beast that appeared in episode 14 of the Great Mazinger anime.
High Hammer Artox Frayhammer was a priest of Moradin as well as the founder of the Templestars. He died a few years before the final battle in the Weeping War.
Pharobos was a gargantuan Egyptian pharaoh themed Warrior Beast and the monster-of-the-week for episode 24 of Great Mazinger.

Sakura smiles at her opponent before glaring and summoning her giant inner self. Inner Sakura yells "I'm speaking from the heart!" as she punches her opponent. The screen shatters, revealing it all to have been a genjutsu and Sakura herself punched her opponent. The foe flies off into the distance. Sakura smiles and says "You should be nice to girls." pl:Kirakira Otome Kokoro
The user makes trees grow rapidly under the opponent, stabbing them and throwing them quite distantly. pl:Mokuton: Jurin Taihō
An assassin's spear was a magical shortspear that, when thrown, granted the thrower invisibility. An assassin's spear was worth around 8000 gold pieces.

Ankoro is a gigantic formerly under the command of captain Vander Decken IX, residing in the Underworld of the Sea, seven thousand meters underneath the ocean surface. Wadatsumi seems to regard Ankoro as a pet, as apparently Ankoro was told "not to eat ships" before.

The Doom Guardian is an entity created by the Great Tree by transforming Gaburi. The initial "present" intended for the Straw Hat Pirates after the clearing her ordeals, the Great Tree turned Gaburi into the Doom Guardian against his will to destroy the crew after getting corrupted by the fear of the dark side of humanity in Gaburi's memories. Although the Straw Hat Pirates managed to separate Gaburi from the Doom Guardian and ultimately get away from it, both Gaburi and the Doom Guardian would one day disappear if they remained apart. As such, the Straw Hat Pirates and Gaburi soon confronted the Doom Guardian once again to have Gaburi take it back from the Great Tree. In the ensuring confrontation, the Great Tree evolved the Doom Guardian into the more powerful Demon of Doom. Regardless, Gaburi managed to successfully remerge with the entity and become whole again. The Doom Guardian serves as the secondary antagonist of One Piece Unlimited Cruise 1: The Treasure Beneath The Waves and One Piece Unlimited Cruise 2: Awakening of a Hero.
Eiri is a giant who resided on Elbaph 63 years ago. He was once severely injured by a young Charlotte Linlin.

Aszundar Zel was a diplomat of the city of Neverwinter on the Sword Coast North in the 1350s DR. Around 1354 DR, Aszundar Zel paid a visit to the royal court of Cormyr and met Princess Alusair Obarskyr, later describing her as "impish" and "winsomely beautiful".

Goldberg is a giant from Elbaph who is the cook of the New Giant Warrior Pirates and was formerly an S-Class ranked mercenary for Buggy's Delivery. He is a major ally of the Straw Hat Pirates during the Elbaph Arc.

Kashii, together with Oimo, was one of the two giants who guarded the front gate of Enies Lobby for over fifty years until he and Oimo realized they were tricked by the World Government. He is a member of the Giant Warrior Pirates. He and Oimo became major allies to the Straw Hat Pirates during the Enies Lobby Arc and Egghead Arc.
The Bittercold is the main antagonist of the game Pokémon Mystery Dungeon: Gates to Infinity. It is an entity made from negative emotions that threatens to destroy the world from the Glacier Palace.
Aundegul Shawn was the owner of the Blade and Stars inn in Baldur's Gate in 1359 DR.

This Rayquaza is a /-type Shiny Legendary Pokémon owned by Roy, and formerly owned by Lucius. Currently, it is resting in the shrine, protected by Team Dragon Rampage, until it has been recovered by a piece of meteorite with the help of Professor Friede, later released after purified the Laquium Core.
The Black Panther was the protector of Wakanda. T'Challa was the Black Panther as well as king of Wakanda.

The Kalisk, classified as Specimen XX0522 by Weyland-Yutani Corporation, was a gigantic creature native to the planet Genna. It was said to be the definitive apex predator. A female Kalisk was hunted by the Dek to prove himself to his clan. At the same time, she was hunted by synthetics of the Weyland-Yutani Corporation. Her pup, nicknamed Bud, was accidentally adopted by Dek and the synthetic Thia and later befriended when Bud was returned to her, Dek instead choosing to claim the skull of Weyland-Yutani combat synthetic Tessa for his coming-of-age hunt and to show up his father when Tessa killed her to escape from her stomach.

Aumry's staff of the night, also known as Aumry's staff of the hulk was a magical staff once possessed by Aumry, Lord of Shadowdale between 1300 DR and 1339 DR. It was an example of a staff of night. but of very different appearance and make and with its own particular history.

Daggoth, the Overmind's right hand and one of its greatest cerebrates, was the master of the Tiamat Brood, the largest and most powerful brood within the Zerg Swarm. Daggoth served the Overmind with ferocity and valor. In order to support his own operations, Daggoth had access to the Hunter Killer, a special and powerful type of hydralisk. Daggoth was easily one of the strongest willed cerebrates, often advising other cerebrates as to how they could best serve the Overmind, even issuing orders to other cerebrates.

Serdath is a dark archon who commanded a legion of dark archons. In an alternate timeline where Zeratul survived the early stages of the End War, Serdath and his legions aided Zeratul against Amon and his forces.

Mokujin Monster, or Final Beast is a monster exclusively found in the Tekken movie Tekken: Blood Vengeance. It consists of more than a thousand ordinary Mokujins, controlled by Heihachi Mishima who is inside it.

Astral Blade was a variety of enchanted long swords created on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR, with the presumed original and the most powerful variety being an artifact recovered from the Northkeep by the bard Leldor.

The Cyber Research Systems Series 850 Terminator, also known as T-850 Terminator or T-850 Battle Robot, is a variant of the Series 800 Terminator mass-produced by Skynet in Rise of the Machines timeline.

The Cyberdyne Systems Series 1000000 Advanced Prototype Sentinel Unit, also known as T-1000000 and often referred to as the T-Meg, was a gigantic, spider-like non-humanoid Hunter Killer entirely made of the same mimetic polyalloy as the T-1000.
Bargrisar, a renegade Stone Giant in league with Agandaûr, is one of the primary antagonists of Snowblind Studios' hack-and-slash RPG The Lord of the Rings: War in the North.
Astar Graysteel was a disgraced Blade of Mulmaster and an adventuring mercenary, active in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
__NOTOC__ Meneldor was a Great Eagle who dwelt at one of the eyries in the northern half of the Misty Mountains.

Tarlang was a mythical giant mentioned only in some legends. The name later became a common personal name among Gondorians that may have originated as "a nickname applied to men of haughty carriage or mood".

The Fall of Fingolfin was the name given to the noble, yet hopeless, end of Fingolfin, High King of the Noldor, at the hands of Morgoth. After the destruction of the Dagor Bragollach, Fingolfin rode his horse Rochallor across Dor-nu-Fauglith, and those that saw him pass took him for Oromë, so great was his rage. He rode in fury to the gates of Angband, where he sounded his horn, beat upon the great doors, and challenged Morgoth to single combat. Morgoth could not refuse such a challenge before his captains, and left his stronghold for the last time during those wars. He came forth in black armour, with his great shield and his Iron Crown. He swung the great hammer Grond, seeking to smite Fingolfin, but the King leaped aside. The hammer made great pits in the ground where it fell. Fingolfin wounded Morgoth seven times as they fought, but he began to weary. Three times Fingolfin fell to his knees, but each time he rose and continued to fight. At last, however, he stumbled in one of the pits left by Grond. But even as Morgoth set his great foot upon him to crush him, Fingolfin stabbed the foot of Morgoth with his sword. So perished Fingolfin, and Morgoth sought to cast his broken body to his wolves. But Thorondor swooped down on Morgoth, scarring his face and carrying the body of the King to a mountain-top. There Turgon built a cairn over him, and no Orc would go near it. Morgoth walked with a limp ever afterwards, and would always bear the wounds from that battle.
The Astral Prism, also referred to as the weapon or mysterious artifact, was the name given to a powerful gith device that appeared in the Realms during the late 15 century DR.

]] Hounds were dogs bred for hunting. Hounds were among the favorite animals of Oromë. The greatest of all hounds in the histories of Middle-earth was Huan the Hound of Valinor, one of the Hounds of Oromë, who defeated Sauron in single combat.

Othuum (The Oceanic Horror) is a Great Old One from the expanded Cthulhu Mythos. It was first mentioned in Brian Lumley's short story "Rising with Surtsey", and was later incorporated into the Call of Cthulhu role-playing game.

Poseidon is the name of the primary sea-god of Classical Greek mythology. Later, in Roman mythology, Neptune was equated with it. For this reason, this article explains both gods. Poseidon and Neptune have been mentioned in a handful of stories and poems, both those set in the Cthulhu Mythos and as references to their real-world aspects.
Aster Merris was the regional leader of the Forgotten Lords, a major prosperous trading cartel active across the Sword Coast in the late 14 century DR.
Phorcys is a monster from Greek mythology. The Marvel Comics incarnation first appeared in the 2nd issue of the comic book miniseries X-Men vs Agents of Atlas by Jeff Parker and Gabriel Hardman.

Toth is a colossal burrowing arthropodal horror which appeared in William Browning Spencer's short story "Usurped". Toth is served by humans, such as the one in the story in which it appears, which can send insectoid creatures, the size of normal insects, to sting or bite victims. Once bitten by one of Toth's insectoid servants, a person is slowly possessed by its evil alien intelligence.

Space slugs are large, slug-like, robotic life-forms that live deep in Cybertron's core. They are part of Cybertron's natural immune system and are immune to the corruptive properties of Dark Energon. They can travel through liquidized Dark Energon without being harmed, as most other Cybertronians would be damaged with this contact, and Space Slugs also can destroy Dark Energon crystals or other types of corruption.
Assassin initiate's leathers were sets of enchanted light armor worn by servants of Shar, her shadar-kai, and rogues of Returned Netheril in the late 15 century DR.
Archid is the intermediary form of the Mokolé. It is a powerful war form considered to be the "true shape" of any individual Mokolé.
Deep Eyes, known to the Uratha as Sus Haz, are immense and powerful kraken spirits, the youngest of which have been known to act as totems to seafaring packs.
Feng-Huang, Emperor of Birds, is a totem unique to the Jade Sentai.
Assassin's dice was a set of two enchanted mythic dice, used as a unique sort of ranged weapon by assassins of the Underdark.
Fomorians is a term used to describe a brutal and powerful race of misshapen monsters. Also referred to as the "Elder Darks", they appear as colossi constructed from man's primal fears.

In Aztec mythology, the world has gone through several iterations defined by their "sun", driven by particular gods. Each had their own dominant people, and the first were a group of giants known only as the First Sun People. After untold years of existence, they were largely destroyed by a plague of jaguars sent by Tezcatlipoca after Quetzalcoatl deposed him as the sun. By the time of the current cycle, the Fifth Sun, the First Sun People remain in small groups, deep within the jungles, only offering trade to the rare individuals they find trustworthy. Though skilled warriors, they are deathly afraid of jaguars, which remain a significant weakness to them, and are hunted still by some of the few remaining Tezcatlipoca-empowered jaguars and by the ocelomeh, who view the hunt as a test of skill.
Magni Mountain-Breaker is a Get of Fenris, and the former leader of the Sept of Anvil Klaiven. Karin Jarlsdottir is his daughter.
Athyr Worrel was a Cormyrean armor trader in the late 15 century DR.
Michael Faraday is an Archmage of Forces, though he is referred as High Scientist of Forces. He was arguably the strongest Archmage of Forces the Technocracy has ever known.
Olokuta (pronounced O-LO-koo-tah) is the Orisha of stone. This is also the Eshu name for the Nocker kith.
The Red Badge Recruiter is a Gargantuan Ogre devoted to the cause of the Red Badge.

Astil adh Saida al Manshaka was a human fighter and a founder and leader of the Clenched Fist, a Rundeen-affiliated mercenary and adventuring company based in Schamedar in Calimshan in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
glyph for the Storm Eater.]] The Storm Eater is a huge Bane that ravaged the American West during the 1800s.

Turtle is a Totem of Respect, a mighty spirit of earth and water said to hold up the world. Turtle was the totem of the Garou tribe known as the Croatan. The spirit taught them much about fortitude and enduring hardship, and with their disappearance, he fell into a slumber from which he has yet to wake.
Vayu also known as Vata, Vayu-Vata, Ram, is the God of wind and air.
Athame was an enchanted sickle of unknown origins found on the Sword Coast North in the late 14 century DR.
Vritra is a powerful Tzimisce Autarkis who arrived in New York City in 2024, becoming the self-appointed ruler of the .

A'dal is the naaru leader of the Sha'tar and rules Shattrath with a gentle demeanor. It shimmers like a chained sun. Unleashed, A'dal's power might destroy cities or topple mountains. It is a quest giver located in the central dome of the Terrace of Light next to Khadgar, in the neutral city of Shattrath.
Andorgos is a blue dragon and a member of the Brood of Malygos.

Baalbisan was a balor who was trapped within Ammon Jerro's haven in the Sword Mountains in the late 14 century DR for the purpose of empowering the warlock. He was in a constant feud with several of the other imprisoned demons and devils, but in the he broke free when he convinced Shandra Jerro to spill her blood to undo the magic that bound the demons to the haven. Baalbisan's matron was named Zaxis.

Anomalus is a gigantic arcane elemental boss in the Nexus. He came into being when the Rift formed due to the high amounts of magical energy streaming through the Nexus daily. He was used as one of the guards to the Nexus and to Keristrasza's prison. Now, Anomalus seems to have gone out of control as his Chaos Rifts and lesser Arcane elementals are attacking the blue dragonflight.
Aoagosa is a blue dragon frozen in time at Eon's Fringe in Thaldraszus.

Archaedas was one of the titan keepers tasked by the Pantheon to watch over Azeroth in their absence. He was imbued by the titan Khaz'goroth with mastery over the earth and forging. He notably created the subterranean chambers imprisoning the Old Gods, as well as the Chamber of Heart, and is a guardian of the Discs of Norgannon. Although believed dead for some time following an incursion by adventurers into Uldaman, according to a note from Spymaster Mathias Shaw, Archaedas may have been "merely disabled".

An axe was a single- or double-bladed weapon made from a metal or stone head mounted on a haft of varying length. The haft was usually made of wood to reduce the overall weight. The term "axe" is used here as an archetype of hand-held slashing weapons that fit this description and where the Blade length is considerably less then the overall weapon length. Axes were the favored weapons of many fighters and barbarians (especially dwarves).

:"Celestials" redirects here. For the world boss encounters, see Chi-Ji (tactics), Niuzao (tactics), Xuen (tactics), and Yu'lon (tactics). For the in-game faction, see August Celestials. .]] guarding the entrance to the Vale of Eternal Blossoms.]] animated shorts.]] The August Celestials (also known as the August Ones or simply the celestials) are four powerful Wild Gods who dwell in and watch over Pandaria. They consist of Chi-Ji, the Red Crane, Niuzao, the Black Ox, Xuen, the White Tiger, and Yu'lon, the Jade Serpent.
Ayamiss the Hunter is a silithid wasp boss in the Ruins of Ahn'Qiraj.

Boden the Imposing is an elite stone lord giant in Deepholm. Boden is the one that leads the assault against the Earthen Ring stationed at the Temple of Earth. At Earthmender Norsala's behest, adventurers attempt to parley with Boden to secure peace between the Earthen Ring and the stone lords. Boden, however, rejects the peace offer; the only way to peace is for the Earthen Ring to hand over the World Pillar to them and leave Deepholm. He unwittingly gives out the name of the one stone lord who may listen and to begin the process of cooperation between the two forces, which is Diamant. After cooperation is reached, he sends adventurers to Terrath the Steady to remove the twilight flight from the skies of Deepholm.
The Axe Kingdoms were a pair of merrow kingdoms, Khuur and Nmalk, in Serôs under the Sea of Fallen Stars in the 6th and 7th centuries DR. They represented the last of merrow civilization in Serôs.
Char is a large earth elemental located at the Slagmire in the Waking Shores.

Cliff Giants are mountain giants found northwestern Feralas, fighting Corrupted Cliff Giants. When they felt the land being corrupted by the Emerald Nightmare they weeped tears of sorrow, and although they no longer weep, those same tears can be used to seal the portal to the Emerald Dream.

, built in the corpse of the rumored last colossal.]] Colossals or colossi, sometimes referred to as earth giants, were an immense species of giant that once lived on Draenor before being driven extinct. They were enormously large, could possess either one or two eyes and were the ones who first shaped Draenor. The colossals were the ancestors of the magnaron and the gronn, and by extension the ogron, ogre lords, ogres and orcs. The only signs of their passing were the Temples of the Damned built during the Second War. Several massive colossal skeletons can be found across the alternate Draenor, but it seems these remains were destroyed along with the rest of Draenor in the main universe.

Azan Stonesplitter was the owner and proprietor of Ironhand's Arms, a weapon shop in Highcastle, in the late 1400s DR. His store offered quality weapons at fair prices for the local Dalesmen and travelers who often passed through on the road between Cormyr and Sembia. Azan was also a capable blacksmith and could forge excellent weapons for patrons so requested.
Colossal Glaciers are ice elementals located in the Primalist Future.
The Corpse of Saragosa is a blue dragon located at the Coldarra in the Borean Tundra.
Cowardly Deathwing is a Cowardly version of Deathwing according to Lucien Tosselwrench. After seeing the giant gnome, he hid in the sun, only to be thrown by the gnome to Kalimdor.
Axe Rock was a projecting crag of rock that travelers on the Evermoor Way used as a landmark.

__NOTOC__ Daenistrasz is a frost wyrm located at the bottom of the Great Sea. He was one of the red dragons that destroyed the Kul Tiran Third Fleet during the Second War, while the dragons were controlled by the Horde.
Dargonax was a twilight dragon created by Sintharia, who regarded the mighty creature as her child. He appears in the World of Warcraft novel Night of the Dragon.

Dills is a sea giant that can be seen talking to a large carp named Nimmy on a ledge overlooking Gral's Grotto in Zuldazar. At an unspecified point in time, he fought in the Battle of Scarvin's Trench, which he claims was both glorious and horrifying, and later befriended Korl. He claims that everyone has heard of Scarvin's Trench, and strongly dislike barnacles, having been told by Korl that anyone who likes them are evil.
The axe of hurling was a unique magical axe that would return to its owner.
Dorbash the Smasher was an ettin located in Highmountain. He was killed by the Order of the Broken Temple when they decided to camp on his mountain.
Advespas were female baatezu devils that resembled huge, black wasps. They monitored the blackened skies of the infernal planes and captured those they were commanded to.

Akar Kessel was an unskilled mage who lived in Luskan's Host Tower of the Arcane under the tutelage of Morkai the Red. Corrupted by the artifact Crenshinibon, Kessel rose to power as a warlord in Icewind Dale before being slain by Drizzt Do'Urden.
The axe of heavenly fire was an impressive, magical greataxe that was considered sacred to the church of Tyr.
Athearsauriv was a mithral dragon demigod, and one of the exarchs of Ioun.
Azurax Silverhawk was a famed archmage and planewalker of the mid–14 century DR.

Barlguras ( ) or bar-lguras, also known as leaping demons, were bestial tanar'ri demons that resembled orangutans. Their ape-like qualities reflected their savage nature, fearsome power, and tribal mentality.
Azuth's spell shield, also known as mass spell resistance, was a powerful spell used by clerics of the Church of Azuth to wrap their allies in protective magic.
Bexendral was a gold dragon and a prince of Dawnfire during the Dawn Age around .
Bhaal ( ), known as Niynjushigampo among his Gugari worshipers, was the widely feared Lord of Murder, the Faerûnian god of violence and ritualistic killing.
Brindol the Burned was a firesoul genasi and the leader of the genasi faction that lived in the Dominion of the Burned in Glaur as of 1479 DR.

Babette Maelestrom was a female adventurer and scavenger active some time before 1368 DR. She was best known for creating the Eyes of Truth helmet to help her in excavating dark dungeons. She attributed all of the wealth she had gathered to its creation, but her keen eyes were as much responsible.
Brimir was renowned frost giant brewer in Jotunheim, the land of giants on the plane of Ysgard, and was the operator of a notable beer-hall and "settlement" in Jotunheim known as Okalnir.
Brimthorn the Scorched King was powerful pit fiend gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos at the very end of the 15 century DR.
The Lady's Mage Cadellin Firehands was a powerful wizard inhabiting Saerloon, Sembia, in the mid–14 century DR.
An avenging hammer was a magical warhammer that only the physically strongest could wield.
The Great Caesar was a ghost that haunted various parts of the Kingdom of Mertwig around the 14 century DR.
Caminus was a red dragon in Damara who was slain in the late 14 century DR. He laird in the lava-filled crater of a volcano.
Canthraxis was a blue dragon dracolich living in the Moonshae Isles around 1370 DR.
The Axe of the Unyielding was a powerful enchanted battleaxe.
Daitya was the stone giant ruler of the Lodge of Faces in the late 15 century DR.

Daurgothoth (), also known as "the Creeping Doom", was a dracolich archmage and one of the most powerful beings in all of Faerûn. Two near-impossible goals consumed him: to become the most powerful creature in the world, and to breed his own race of living dracoliches.

Fafnolt was a giant from Isle Broddick in the Whamite Isles. Fafnolt represented Broddick in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
The Axe of the Phoenix was the surprisingly light enchanted battleaxe that belonged to the dwarves of the House of Gems in Myth Drannor.
